provenance.preprocessing: Application photo-import pipeline: maximum source side 1400, face-directed square crop, CPU IMAGE detector. XYZ are relative estimates, not metric measurements. Only public internet portraits listed in manifest.json are included.
provenance.limitation: Regression fixtures measure geometry only; browser compatibility and real rendered images remain the primary integration evidence.
